ns2:section.sectionText: This course explores the impact of substance use on families through the social ecological framework, including biopsychosocial impacts of substance use on individuals, relationships with family members (including between partners, parents, and children, siblings, extended families), and impacts on family health. The roles of neighborhoods, community, policy, and social factors on families in context of substance use will also be explored. Students will use course concepts and information to develop materials for community outreach and education about substance use and family health.
